trips.title: Thrips (Frankliniella occidentalis)
trips.symptoms: Symptoms: Leaf burns, silver spots, flower and fruit deformation.
trips.damage: Damage: Reduced photosynthetic area, virus transmission, loss of commercial quality.
trips.prevention: Preventive control: Monitoring with blue sticky traps, weed removal, avoid excess nitrogen.
trips.chemical: Chemical control: Apply insecticides from group 3A (pyrethroids) or 4A (neonicotinoids), rotating active ingredients.
trips.organic: Use blue sticky traps, garlic extract, potassium soap, and natural predators like Orius insidiosus and lacewings.

arania.title: Red Spider Mite (Tetranychus urticae)
arania.symptoms: Symptoms: Yellow spots on leaves, fine webs, overall plant weakening.
arania.damage: Damage: Leaf drop, production decrease, total crop weakening in severe cases.
arania.prevention: Preventive control: Ensure proper humidity, avoid water stress, crop rotation.
arania.chemical: Chemical control: Apply acaricides from group 1B (organophosphates) or mineral oils, respecting pre-harvest intervals.
arania.organic: Use wettable sulfur, garlic extract, or predators like Phytoseiulus persimilis and Amblyseius swirskii.

trips.descripcion: Thrips are tiny insects that feed on leaves and flowers, causing visible damage and transmitting viruses that affect crop productivity.
sintomas: Deformation of fruits and virus transmission
trips.epocas: Most common in dry and warm climates, especially from June to September.

arania.descripcion: The red spider mite is a pest that attacks leaves, causing spots and weakening the plant. It reproduces rapidly in dry and hot environments.
sintomas: Presence of fine webs on the underside of leaves
arania.epocas: Frequent during dry seasons with high temperatures (January to April).
prevencion: Biological control using natural predators such as Phytoseiulus persimilis
